chunks: And it is narrated from Abū Wallād Ḥafṣ ibn Sālim al-Ḥannāṭ that he said:
I heard Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام say: “There is no harm in a man praying two rakʿahs of al-Witr, then leaving to attend to his need, then returning to pray one rakʿah.”

key_terms.الْوَتْرِ: the witr prayer of the night prayer
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; an expression indicating permissibility

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to interrupt the witr prayer after two rakʿahs and then return to pray the final rakʿah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the witr prayer in the night prayer. It indicates that there is no objection to praying two rakʿahs of witr, pausing to fulfill a need, and then returning to complete the remaining one rakʿah.
